# Cornel Media Productions (cornel.media)

> Ghana's Premier Full-Service Media, Creative Production, Aerial Drone & Tech Agency.
> Operating in East Legon (Accra) and Tarkwa (Western Region), Ghana. Serving West Africa & International Clients.

## Agency Overview
Cornel Media Productions (CMP) is a leading full-service creative agency and digital engineering company founded by Cornelius Quayson (BSc Computer Science & Engineering). We specialize in fusing high-end cinematic media production with modern tech infrastructure, AI automation, and web development.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Media & Cinematography Services
- **Cinematography & Video Production**: High-end 4K commercial videos, brand documentaries, music videos, corporate events, and social media content creation.
- **Professional Photography**: Executive portraits, corporate campaigns, commercial product photography, fashion shows, and wedding coverage.
- **Aerial Drone Piloting & Drone Mapping**: High-definition aerial videography, 4K orthomosaic mapping, topography surveying, real estate site inspections, and industrial inspection.
- **Multi-Cam Live Streaming**: High-reliability broadcast live streaming for corporate AGMs, summits, weddings, and hybrid international conferences.

### 2. Creative Tech & Digital Solutions
- **Web & Custom App Development**: High-performance corporate websites, e-commerce stores, custom web applications, and web performance optimization.
- **AI Automation & Workflow Integration**: Smart AI tools integration, business process automation, CRM/ERP integrations, and customer service automation.
- **Brand Strategy & Digital Systems**: Digital marketing infrastructure, domain & hosting setup, SEO optimization, and social media management.
